name: WhoisXML API Domain Research Suite (WHOIS History API v1, Reverse WHOIS API v2)
tier_rationale: Established WHOIS data company with published API documentation, terms and paid plans (A8 trusted); P022 chair rationale: 'WhoisXML is trusted' (the module's derived tier is community through Whoxy and WhoisFreaks).

reliability.justification: Large WHOIS-history collection dated by its own audit timestamps; historical records describe the past registration, post-GDPR records are mostly redacted (P022 cond 6).

error_markers.reason: WhoisXML API: DRS credits exhausted or the key is not valid for this product (HTTP 403, could not verify)
WhoisXML API: the egress IP is not on the key's IP allowlist (HTTP 403, could not verify)

whoisxml.description: WhoisXML API key (Domain Research Suite credits), sent in the X-Authentication-Token header, never in the URL
whoisxml.plan_hint: business = a company-paid WhoisXML subscription recorded with its licence/purchase in licence_allow (P022 cond 1); never an analyst's personal free account

drs.title: WhoisXML WHOIS History API v1 (preview 1 / purchase 50 DRS credits) and Reverse WHOIS API v2 (preview free / purchase 1 credit), one shared DRS credit pool

terms.quote: Company-paid keys only; legal records the licence/purchase in licence_allow before an adapter runs under corporate (P022 cond 1). Terms 'license' (paid credits): business use needs the paid subscription.

drs.notes: Quote: binding council text (P022 cond 1, chair rationale 'terms license (paid credits)'); research C0043 (verified_needs_key, keyless WhoisService 401 AUTHENTICATE_04). POST https://whois-history.whoisxmlapi.com/api/v1 {domainName, mode preview|purchase, outputFormat JSON} and POST https://reverse-whois.whoisxmlapi.com/api/v2 {searchType historic, mode, advancedSearchTerms [{field RegistrantContact.Email|Organization|Name, term, exactMatch}]}; key in the documented X-Authentication-Token header (never apiKey in the URL, AR01). Documented errors: 401 key missing/invalid, 403 'insufficient credits balance, incorrect API key, or IP not on the allowlist', 408, 429 (30 requests/s), 5xx. Free plan: 500 DRS credits (one-time, at sign-up); the quota block counts requests, the module's monthly credit budget weights history purchases (50 credits). Used by whois_history_keyed.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-2 (P022 whois_history_keyed). Only the two Domain Research Suite hosts the final conditions use are registered (ip-netblocks/subdomains/www are not used, P327). Responses carry full registrant contacts: the module minimises them at ingestion (P022 cond 5) and keeps only domain, registrar, dates, nameservers, status and usable registrant selectors. Cache 30 days (P022 cond 7).
